recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, kitschy composite image featuring a large ensemble of characters in 1970s-style tropical attire balanced on a single, oversized surfboard riding a massive turquoise wave, set against a backdrop of palm trees and a bright sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the surfboard creates a dynamic sense of motion from top-left to bottom-right.
The curve of the breaking wave frames the characters on the left side.
The bright pink and yellow surfboard contrasts sharply with the deep blue and white sea foam.
The character heights and poses create a rhythmic, cascading visual flow down the board.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large group of people occupies the central diagonal axis, scaled to fit a single longboard.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lead couple at the front of the surfboard (bottom right) serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the crest of the wave down to the characters, then slides down the diagonal of the surfboard to the front.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top right corner and bottom left corner provide breathing room with sky and water respectively.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Turquoise and deep blue (ocean and sky) provide the environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Hot pink and bright yellow (surfboard and title) create high-energy contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Floral greens and reds in the clothing add texture and variety.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all channels to evoke a sunny, comedic, and retro feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, rounded sans-serif with a slight bounce
letterConstructionRules: Overlapping characters to create a cohesive unit
Staggered baseline for a playful effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly tilted in alternating directions
Integrated floral graphic elements near the text

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating over the background sky and palm trees

treatment.outline: Thick yellow stroke with a secondary thin dark drop shadow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A loud, decorative display face paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bouncy, casual, and retro vibe

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-action tropical scene with a massive turquoise wave curling on the left. A long, multi-colored surfboard (pink, yellow, red stripes) is positioned diagonally. On the board, place a large group of 8-10 people in 1970s Hawaiian shirts and dresses, posing theatrically as if surfing together. Background features palm trees and a bright blue sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top right using a heavy, rounded, overlapping font with a magenta fill and yellow outline. Add a small caption in a clean white sans-serif in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main text bouncy and overlapping?
Does the ensemble look like a single unit on the board?

adjustableVariables: Number of characters on the board

avoid: Isolated characters not interacting with the board

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the surfboard looks like it is actually on the water surface.
Check that character shadows align with the bright overhead sun.
Verify the text is legible against the background.
Confirm the 70s fashion aesthetic is consistent across all characters.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a large group of people + place them in an unlikely, high-action shared activity (surfing, skydiving, etc.) + apply a 1970s saturated color grade + add bouncy, multi-outlined display typography.
